title: Broadcast channel buffer overflow with silent drops
description:
What: events.rs creates a broadcast channel with capacity 64 (line 387 in tests, and same in main code per kith_events crate). When StateChange events arrive faster than the coalescing task processes them, the broadcast ring buffer drops old events. Dropped events are logged at DEBUG level (lines 235-239, 273-277), not ERROR.

Why: Phase 2 may generate many concurrent state changes (e.g., Peer/deliver touching Contact, Chat, Message, multiple attachments). If the total exceeds 64 before the coalescing task wakes, events are silently dropped. A solo maintainer monitoring ERROR logs will not see this. Clients must resync via /changes, adding latency. No circuit breaker or backpressure mechanism to push back on senders.

How to apply: (1) Measure Phase 2 workload and increase buffer capacity accordingly, (2) add a counter/metric for dropped events with alerts on threshold, (3) add an integration test that deliberately overfills the buffer and verifies clients are told to resync, then succeed.
